title: Jill Is Rooting for a Crash?! | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: You heard that right: Jill is rooting for a market crash. In today's episode, Certified Financial Planner Kayla Sabbagh joins Jill and Mark to explain why Jill might be onto something—and how, in some cases, a market crash can be good for your wallet. Plus, Jill and the gang help caller Jessica make a financial plan for her move across the country.
